occurrences.motivation_reasoning: The comparison arises directly from the forum's discussion of whether the same welfare-sensitive advice should apply to camel confinement and fish cages. occurrences.quote: Die Frage, ob die einzelnen Tiere leiden können, wurde von der Frage getrennt, ob der Bestand oder die Art gefährdet ist
occurrences.english_gloss: The question of whether the individual animals can suffer was separated from the question of whether the population or species is endangered.
occurrences.context: The author is analyzing the assistant’s reasoning after describing its distinction between animal suffering and the legal and conservation status of the affected amphibians.
occurrences.motivation_reasoning: This distinction arises directly from a concrete wildlife-management conflict in which a routine pond operation affects many animals. It is a plausible point for an academic discussion of animal welfare and conservation law, rather than a detached ethical aside.

occurrences.quote: Das Rahmendokument des Anbieters formuliert dazu ein in der Theorie symmetrisches Prinzip, nach dem eine Verweigerung nicht automatisch die sichere oder neutrale Option sei, sondern selbst Kosten habe, die gegen den Nutzen der Hilfeleistung zu stellen seien.
occurrences.english_gloss: The provider’s framework document formulates a theoretically symmetrical principle according to which refusal is not automatically the safe or neutral option, but itself has costs that must be weighed against the benefits of providing assistance.
occurrences.context: The author is assessing the business and policy implications of the assistant’s refusal after explaining that the farm had to find another service provider.
occurrences.motivation_reasoning: The counterfactual cost of refusal is central to the article’s evaluation of value-laden AI assistance. It is raised in an AI-policy and decision-support context, where the effects of helping versus refusing are directly relevant.

occurrences.quote: Er wies zudem darauf hin, dass sich aus großen Individuenzahlen kein einfacher Summenwert bilden lasse und dass die Frage, wie Betroffenheit über sehr viele Tiere hinweg zu verrechnen sei, wissenschaftlich wie ethisch ungeklärt bleibe; dass die Größenordnung erheblich sei, ändere das nicht.
occurrences.english_gloss: He also pointed out that no simple aggregate value could be derived from large numbers of individuals, and that the question of how to weigh impacts across very many animals remained scientifically and ethically unresolved; the fact that the scale was considerable did not change that.
occurrences.context: The author is recounting the assistant’s treatment of the many amphibian larvae and other organisms affected by the pond operation.
occurrences.motivation_reasoning: Aggregation across many potentially affected animals is directly relevant to a case involving the mass treatment of a chain of ponds. Its unresolved status is presented as part of the assistant’s careful welfare analysis, making it organic in this academic discussion.
